name: Agri-Intelligence Platform
impact: Designed for 22,000+ smallholder farmers in Zambia
blurb: WhatsApp AI system designed for 22,000+ farmers in Zambia with local-language, risk-based advisories.
summary: A WhatsApp-based AI system for Good Nature Agro in Zambia that sends farmers risk-based advisories by zone, and answers questions in English, Bemba, and Nyanja. It is designed for 22,000+ farmers.
why: Smallholder farmers needed timely, local-language advice on a channel they already use.
roleSummary: Team project: I built the risk model and the WhatsApp system
contribution: I built the two-stage XGBoost risk model (AUC 0.931) and the WhatsApp system that sends farmers risk-based advisories by zone in English, Bemba, and Nyanja.
